verified_facts.text: Royal Malewane is located within the Greater Kruger National Park in Limpopo, South Africa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Royal Malewane is located within the Greater Kruger National Park in Limpopo, South Africa

verified_facts.text: No fences separate Royal Malewane's reserve from the Kruger National Park, and wildlife roams freely across the protected area.
verified_facts.excerpt: There are no fences separating Royal Malewane’s reserve with the Kruger National Park and wildlife roams freely across the protected area.

verified_facts.text: Royal Malewane is in the Thornybush Private Nature Reserve.
verified_facts.excerpt: Royal Malewane is in the Thornybush Private Nature Reserve

verified_facts.text: Royal Malewane has four lodges: Malewane Lodge, The Farmstead, Waterside and Masiya's Camp.
verified_facts.excerpt: There are four lodges at Royal Malewane: Malewane Lodge, The Farmstead, Waterside and Masiya’s Camp.

verified_facts.text: Royal Malewane is also home to three exclusive-use private villas: Africa House, Waterside House and Farmhouse.
verified_facts.excerpt: Royal Malewane is also home to three exclusive-use private villas: Africa House, Waterside House and Farmhouse.

verified_facts.text: Malewane Lodge has a classic layout and an elegant interior style with dark woods, and vast raised decks overlooking the African bushveld.
verified_facts.excerpt: Malewane Lodge is bigger with a classic layout and elegant interior style with dark woods, and vast, raised decks overlooking the African bushveld.

verified_facts.text: Waterside is vast and spacious, with playful colour that reflects the brighter details of the bush.
verified_facts.excerpt: Waterside is vast and spacious with plenty of playful colour that reflects the brighter details of the bush.

verified_facts.text: Masiya's Camp is a tented camp named after the tracker Wilson Masiya.
verified_facts.excerpt: Named after legendary tracker, Wilson Masiya, this tented camp adds colour to canvas.

verified_facts.text: The Farmstead is more contemporary and laid back, a homely, light and more compact space.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Farmstead is more contemporary and laid back – a homely, light and more compact space ideal for an exclusive-use booking.

verified_facts.text: Africa House is the original Biden family homestead, reinvented as a safari villa.
verified_facts.excerpt: The original Biden family homestead has been reinvented as the ultimate safari villa.

verified_facts.text: Liz and Phil Biden opened Royal Malewane in the Greater Kruger National Park in 1999.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our journey started in 1999 when Liz and Phil Biden opened Royal Malewane in South Africa’s Greater Kruger National Park.

verified_facts.text: Africa House welcomes children of all ages and comes with a dedicated chef, guide, tracker and exclusive safari vehicles.
verified_facts.excerpt: Africa House welcomes children of all ages, hosting up to 12 guests in a roomy villa with dedicated chef, guide, tracker and exclusive safari vehicles.

verified_facts.text: Farmhouse is an exclusive-use villa with a deck and a swimming pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: offering exclusive use and personal service, where a magnificent deck with an inviting swimming pool blends with the rugged terrain of the wilderness.

verified_facts.text: The Royal Waters Spa at Malewane Lodge has a fitness centre, sauna, cold plunge, outdoor baths and a hair salon.
verified_facts.excerpt: as well as a fully equipped fitness centre, sauna, cold plunge, outdoor baths and a hair salon.

verified_facts.text: The Royal Waters Spa is set around a central courtyard with a heated lap pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Recently reimagined and positioned around a central courtyard with a 25m heated lap pool are three tranquil treatment rooms

verified_facts.text: The Reflections Spa at Waterside has a Hammam.
verified_facts.excerpt: focused on the balance between body and mind in our three treatment rooms as well as our Hammam.

verified_facts.text: Guests can go on twice daily game drives.
verified_facts.excerpt: witness Africa’s abundant wildlife on twice daily game drives

verified_facts.text: Guided walks through the Greater Kruger National Park are offered.
verified_facts.excerpt: There’s something almost primal about a guided walk through the Greater Kruger National Park.

verified_facts.text: Guests can visit the Conservation & Research Centre at Royal Malewane.
verified_facts.excerpt: Visit the Conservation & Research Centre, where groundbreaking science meets wildlife preservation

verified_facts.text: The guides have earned the country's top qualifications in birding.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our guides have earned the country’s top qualifications in birding

verified_facts.text: Each of the main dining areas at Royal Malewane overlooks a different waterhole.
verified_facts.excerpt: each of the main dining areas at Royal Malewane overlooks a different bustling waterhole, resulting in some spectacular mealtime game viewings.

verified_facts.text: Rates are all-inclusive: meals, game drives, soft drinks, house wines, local beverages and the in-room mini-bar are included, excluding premium beverages.
verified_facts.excerpt: all your meals, game drives, soft-drinks, house wines, and local beverages are included, as well as the mini-bar in your room (excludes premium beverages)

verified_facts.text: Hoedspruit's Eastgate Airport is the closest airport, a 45-minute drive from the lodges.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hoedspruit’s Eastgate Airport is the closest airport at a 45-minute drive from the lodges.

verified_facts.text: Royal Malewane has its own private landing strip, Royal Malewane Airstrip.
verified_facts.excerpt: Royal Malewane also has its own private landing strip called Royal Malewane Airstrip.

verified_facts.text: Children over 10 are welcome in the Luxury Suites at Malewane Lodge, the Luxury Farm Suites at Farmstead and the Luxury Tented Suites at Masiya's Camp.
verified_facts.excerpt: Children over 10 are welcome in the Luxury Suites at Malewane Lodge, the Luxury Farm Suites at Farmstead and the Luxury Tented Suites at Masiya’s Camp.

verified_facts.text: Waterside welcomes children of all ages.
verified_facts.excerpt: Waterside welcomes children of all ages.

verified_facts.text: Royal Malewane has a children's programme called Royal Rangers.
verified_facts.excerpt: We have a wonderful children’s programme called Royal Rangers.

verified_facts.text: Royal Malewane is in a low-risk malaria area.
verified_facts.excerpt: Royal Malewane is in a low-risk malaria area

verified_facts.text: The winter months of May to August are considered peak season for game viewing.
verified_facts.excerpt: are considered peak season for good game viewing because the bush is quieter without the presence of so many birds and insects

verified_facts.text: Complimentary WiFi is available throughout Royal Malewane.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, there is complimentary WiFi throughout Royal Malewane.
